steps.title: Prepare cell culture media
steps.instruction: Mix 450 mL DMEM, 5 mL penicillin/streptomycin solution, and 50 mL fetal bovine serum in a sterile container; store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 1 × PBS(-)
steps.instruction: Dilute 50 mL of 20 × PBS(-) with Milli‑Q water to a final volume of 1 000 mL (room temperature, 22–28 °C).

steps.title: Make Solution A (1 M Tris)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1.21 g Tris base in 10 mL Milli‑Q water in a 50 mL polypropylene tube; store at –30 °C (pH ≈ 9.4).

steps.title: Make Solution B (protease inhibitor)
steps.instruction: Dissolve one tablet of cOmplete EDTA‑free protease inhibitor in 2 mL Milli‑Q water; prepare fresh for each experiment, keep at 4 °C (up to 3 months at –30 °C).

steps.title: Make Solution C (lysis buffer base)
steps.instruction: In a 50 mL tube add 0.6 mL 1 M Tris, 8.40 g urea, 3.04 g thiourea, 0.80 g CHAPS, then add Milli‑Q water to 20 mL; vortex at room temperature; store at –30 °C (3 months).

steps.title: Make Solution D (lysis buffer)
steps.instruction: Combine 2 mL Solution B with 18 mL Solution C (1:9 ratio) to obtain 20 mL containing 27 mM Tris, 6.3 M urea, 1.8 M thiourea, 3.6 % CHAPS; vortex; store at –30 °C (3 months).

steps.title: Prepare 20 mg/mL BSA in Solution D
steps.instruction: Dissolve 20 mg BSA fraction IV in 10 mL Solution D in a 50 mL tube; vortex at room temperature until no gelatinous residue remains.

steps.title: Create diluted BSA standards
steps.instruction: Dilute the 20 mg/mL BSA stock to final concentrations of 0.0625, 0.125, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0, and 1.5 µg/µL in 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes using vortex; aliquot ~100 µL and store at –80 °C if not used immediately.

substeps.instruction: 150 µL of 2.0 µg/µL → 200 µL total (1.5 µg/µL)
100 µL of 2.0 µg/µL → 200 µL total (1.0 µg/µL)
100 µL of 1.0 µg/µL → 200 µL total (0.5 µg/µL)
100 µL of 0.5 µg/µL → 200 µL total (0.25 µg/µL)
100 µL of 0.25 µg/µL → 200 µL total (0.125 µg/µL)
100 µL of 0.125 µg/µL → 200 µL total (0.0625 µg/µL)

steps.title: Prepare diluted GA‑AGEs‑BSA standards
steps.instruction: Dilute 10 mg/mL GA‑AGEs‑BSA in PBS(-) to obtain the following concentrations (final volume 100 µL each): 200 ng/µL (2.0 µL GA‑AGEs‑BSA + 98 µL PBS), 50 ng/µL (20 µL + 80 µL), 30 ng/µL (60 µL + 40 µL), 15 ng/µL (10 µL + 90 µL), 5 ng/µL (10 µL + 90 µL), 1.5 ng/µL (10 µL + 90 µL), 0.5 ng/µL (10 µL + 90 µL). Keep on ice and use immediately.

steps.title: Prepare HRP‑conjugated marker solution
steps.instruction: Mix 3 µL HRP‑conjugated molecular‑weight marker with 197 µL PBS(-) to 200 µL; vortex at room temperature; store at –30 °C until use.

steps.title: Make PBS‑T and SM‑PBS‑T buffers
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.5 mL Tween‑20 in 1 000 mL PBS(-) to obtain PBS‑T (0.05 % Tween‑20). Prepare 5 % SM‑PBS‑T by dissolving 2.5 g skim milk in 50 mL PBS‑T; store at 4 °C (≤2 days). Dilute 5 % SM‑PBS‑T 1:10 with PBS‑T to obtain 0.5 % SM‑PBS‑T (5 mL + 45 mL).

steps.title: Prepare primary antibody solution
steps.instruction: Defrost polyclonal anti‑GA‑AGE antibody at 0 °C (on ice). Mix 5 µL antibody with 5 mL 0.5 % SM‑PBS‑T in a 15 mL tube; vortex 10 s at room temperature; keep on ice (stable 6 months at 4 °C).

steps.title: Prepare neutralized primary antibody solution
steps.instruction: In a 15 mL tube combine 5 µL anti‑GA‑AGE antibody, 125 µL 10 mg/mL GA‑AGEs‑BSA, and 4.875 mL 0.5 % SM‑PBS‑T; vortex 10 s at room temperature. Keep on ice; use immediately.

steps.title: Prepare secondary antibody solution
steps.instruction: Mix 2.5 µL polyclonal goat anti‑rabbit HRP‑conjugated antibody with 5 mL 0.5 % SM‑PBS‑T in a 15 mL tube; vortex 10 s at room temperature; store at 4 °C (stable 2 months).

steps.title: Seed C2C12 cells
steps.instruction: Plate 1.9 × 10⁴ C2C12 cells per cm² onto a 60 mm dish containing complete DMEM; incubate 24 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Treat cells with glyceraldehyde
steps.instruction: Refresh medium 24 h after seeding, then add glyceraldehyde to final concentrations of 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, and 2 mM; incubate another 24 h under the same conditions.

steps.title: Wash cells with PBS(-)
steps.instruction: Decant medium, aspirate residual ~300 µL with a 1 000 µL trap‑flask aspirator (repeat twice). Add 7.0 mL PBS(-), decant, aspirate residual (~300 µL) (repeat twice). Perform all transfers with a 10 mL serological pipette at 22–28 °C.

steps.title: Lyse cells and collect lysate
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL Solution D to the dish, scrape cells into a 1.5 mL tube, and dispense to ensure mixing. Incubate on ice 20 min, pipetting up/down five times, repeat three times with 5–6 min intervals. Centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C; transfer supernatant to a fresh tube and store at –80 °C (along with unused Solution D).

steps.title: Determine protein concentration (Bradford)
steps.instruction: In a 96‑well plate add 4 µL of BSA stock (0–2.0 µg/µL) and 4 µL of each cell lysate (duplicate wells). Add 200 µL Bradford dye reagent (pre‑warmed to 22–28 °C for 30–60 min) to each well using a Nichipet 7000; after 5 min and 10 min read absorbance at 595 nm with an iMark reader.

steps.title: Prepare PVDF membrane and filter papers
steps.instruction: Cut PVDF membrane to 9 cm × 12 cm; immerse in methanol for 1 min (fume hood). Transfer to PBS(-) and incubate three 9 cm × 12 cm filter papers in PBS(-) for 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Assemble slot‑blot apparatus
steps.instruction: Place sealing gasket on vacuum manifold, then gasket support plate, then three filter papers, then the PVDF membrane; incubate the assembled stack in PBS(-) for 1 h at room temperature. Attach the sample template with sealing screws and tighten the four screws to remove air pockets.

steps.title: Prepare sample solutions for slot blot
steps.instruction: Adjust each cell‑lysate sample to contain 2 µg total protein (calculate volume from Bradford data). Add Solution D to reach the volume of the lowest‑protein sample (e.g., if lowest is 10 µL, bring all to 10 µL). Incubate 5 min at room temperature, then add PBS(-) to a final volume of 200 µL (use 50–200 µL pipette).

steps.title: Prepare GA‑AGEs‑BSA standards for slot blot
steps.instruction: In 1.5 mL tubes, combine 2 µL of each GA‑AGEs‑BSA stock (0, 0.5, 1.5, 5, 15, 30, 50 ng/µL) with 2 µL PBS(-) to 4 µL total, then add an equal volume of Solution D (e.g., 4 µL). Incubate 5 min at room temperature, then bring each to 200 µL with PBS(-).

steps.title: Prepare HRP‑marker for slot blot
steps.instruction: Mix 3 µL HRP‑conjugated marker with 3 µL PBS(-) to 6 µL, add 6 µL Solution D, incubate 5 min at room temperature, then bring to 200 µL with PBS(-).

steps.title: Load samples onto PVDF membrane
steps.instruction: Place the slot‑blot apparatus on a 25–30 cm stand near a water aspirator. Add 100 µL PBS(-) to the manifold (no aspiration). Using a 200–1 000 µL pipette, apply 200 µL of each prepared sample, standard, and marker to the appropriate lanes. Vacuum with water aspirator while opening the air valve (Figure 7A); for complete loading, close the air valve for 3–5 s (Figure 7B).

steps.title: Wash PVDF membrane after loading
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL PBS(-) to the manifold and vacuum as above (air valve open; optionally close for 3–5 s).

steps.title: Rinse membrane with Milli‑Q water
steps.instruction: Remove the membrane from the apparatus, place it in a disposable polypropylene tray, and rinse in Milli‑Q water for 1 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Block membrane in SM‑PBS‑T
steps.instruction: Cut membrane into 9 cm × 6 cm pieces, place each piece in a tray with 15 mL 5 % SM‑PBS‑T, and incubate 30 min at room temperature on a seesaw shaker.

steps.title: Wash before primary antibody
steps.instruction: Wash each membrane piece twice with 10 mL 0.5 % SM‑PBS‑T for 5 min at room temperature on the shaker.

steps.title: Incubate with primary antibodies
steps.instruction: Pack membranes in Hybri‑Bags containing either primary antibody solution or neutralized primary antibody solution (≈5 mL each). Incubate 1 h at room temperature on shaker, then overnight at 4 °C on shaker.

steps.title: Wash after primary antibody
steps.instruction: Remove membranes from bags and wash three times with 10 mL 0.5 % SM‑PBS‑T for 10 min each at room temperature on shaker.

steps.title: Incubate with secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Pack each membrane in a Hybri‑Bag with 5 mL secondary antibody solution; incubate 1 h at room temperature on shaker.

steps.title: Wash after secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Wash membranes twice with 15 mL PBS‑T for 10 min each at room temperature on shaker (optional pause 3–12 h). Then wash once with 15 mL PBS(-) for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Develop chemiluminescence
steps.instruction: In a dark area, mix 500 µL Reagent A and 500 µL Reagent B from the ImmunoStar LD kit (total 1 000 µL). Smear each membrane piece with the mixture for 10 s at room temperature, let stand 30 s, then place on a polyvinylidene chloride sheet.

steps.title: Capture images
steps.instruction: Place membranes in the Fusion FX imager; acquire images in standard mode with exposure times ranging from 0.5 to 30 s (e.g., 10, 15, 20, 30 s). Use high or ultra mode if needed.

description: Validation of protocol This protocol or parts of it have been used and validated in Takata et al. [14] (DOI: 10.1186/s13098-020-00561-z). The chemiluminescence bands on PVDF membranes are shown in Supplementary Figure 1a of Takata et al. [14]. The detection of bands of standard GA-AGEs-BSA and intracellular GA-AGE using the novel slot blot approach was validated in various cells under the same or similar protocols [10–13,15–17].
